instruction: Modify the heading in LibreOffice Writer so its font size is 16pt.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

The evaluator checks if all runs in the first paragraph have font size 16pt. The original document heading has an unspecified default font size.
